image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a green tiger beetle (Cicindelinae) perched on a rough, light-colored rocky surface. The beetle features a vibrant metallic green exoskeleton with distinct pale cream-colored markings on its elytra. Its head is broad with large compound eyes and visible mandibles. Long, thin antennae extend forward, and slender legs are splayed out for grip.
